markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (91%)** · Ambiguous: InSitu vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive carcinoma (5%) remains in the 90% conformal set on this simulated frozen section [F1].

## Confidence
|Signal|Value|Reading|
|---|---|---|
|Top probabilities|InSitu 91%, Invasive 5%, Benign 4%, Normal 0% (ECE 5%, n=132)|Favors InSitu; small test set|
|Conformal set|InSitu, Invasive (90% target; 90% coverage, n=132)|Invasive unexcluded at dataset guarantee|
|Reliability / OOD|96% reliability, 100th-percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] (AUROC 70%)|Passes QC; moderate error ranking|
|CONCH–MUSK agreement|True (same top class)|Independent foundation models concur|
|Similar cases|5/5 InSitu (82%–88%) [F5]; contrast Invasive BACH_0212 (79%)|Unanimous InSitu neighbor match|

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Top anti-invasive score (-0.59) [F2]; 12/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 0) · context · Below-typical (-0.06), descriptive weight (+0.54) [F3]; 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Anti-invasive score (-0.43) [F4]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 0, 4, 6) · ↑ invasive · Pro-invasive score (+0.29); 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **HoVer-Net nuclei** (regions 1, 3, 6) · context · 81% tumor cells (99th percentile) [F7]; size CV 100th percentile [F9] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions beat random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); uses unreliable normal_lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal stromal invasion exists in high-risk regions 1, 6, 11 or region 3, matching Invasive case BACH_0212.
- Simulated frozen-section artifacts (100th-percentile OOD, stains blocked) mask invasion or inflate four-margin positivity (108–430 µm) [F11].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 6, 11**: Inspect top heatmap-risk areas (52%, 35%, 21%) and 144 neoplastic nuclei for invasion.
2. **Region 3**: Check validated stromal invasion signal (0.70, 19/20 spot check) against Invasive case BACH_0212.
3. **Regions 0, 8, 9**: Confirm duct confinement and predicted tumor at superior, inferior, medial, and lateral margins.
